hooks.command: o=$(python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/check-staleness.py" 2>&1); rc=$?; printf "%s\n" "$o" > "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.staleness-report.txt"; s=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL)" | head -2 | tr "\n" "; "); if [ -z "$s" ]; then s="CHECKER CRASHED (exit $rc) - it printed no PASS or FAIL line. Run tools/check-staleness.py directly; the traceback is in .staleness-report.txt"; fi; jq -n --arg s "$s" '{systemMessage: ("staleness: " + $s), hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse", additionalContext:("staleness check: " + $s + " Detail is in .staleness/report.txt (NOT .staleness-report.txt, which holds only this summary) - read it when fixing, do not re-run for detail.")}}'
